readings: For each observatory station, count its telescopes and work out its share of all telescopes (its count divided by the total number of telescopes). Among observatories whose share is above the average share across all observatories, list the `observstation`, the telescope count, the share, and how far the share is above the average (share minus average share), with no rounding. Sort by that difference from largest to smallest and return exactly the first 10 rows; if observatories are tied at the 10th place, just pick any of them to fill the 10 rows.
queries:
WITH telescope_counts AS (
    SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
    FROM observatories AS o
    LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY o.observstation
),
shares AS (
    SELECT observstation,
           telescope_count,
           1.0 * telescope_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
    FROM telescope_counts
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.telescope_count,
       s.share,
       s.share - a.value AS share_above_average
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE s.share > a.value
ORDER BY share_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10
